nodes.description: GovernorAlpha.timelock: privileged TimelockInterface used for queue/execute/cancel of proposal actions.
GovernorAlpha.proposals: mapping of proposalId to Proposal struct holding actions, votes and flags.
GovernorAlpha.guardian: privileged address authorized for cancel and timelock admin helpers.
Timelock.queuedTransactions: mapping marking a txHash as queued/executable.
GAMERRebaser.rebasingActive: boolean gate that must be true for rebase execution.
GAMERRebaser.uniswap_pair: address of the GAMER/Reserve uniswap pair used for swaps.
GovernorAlpha.propose: creates a proposal after checking proposer votes from gamer.getPriorVotes(msg.sender,...).
GovernorAlpha.queue: computes eta from block.timestamp and timelock.delay(), queues each action.
GovernorAlpha.execute: payable loop performing external value calls via timelock.executeTransaction.
GovernorAlpha.cancel: guardian or below-threshold proposer cancels a proposal and its timelock txs.
GovernorAlpha._queueOrRevert: internal helper forwarding action data to timelock.queueTransaction.
GovernorAlpha._castVote: internal vote accounting reading gamer.getPriorVotes and writing receipts.
GovernorAlpha.castVote: public entry passing msg.sender into _castVote.
GovernorAlpha.state: view computing ProposalState using block.number, block.timestamp and grace period.
GovernorAlpha.__acceptAdmin: guardian-only call to timelock.acceptAdmin().
GovernorAlpha.__queueSetTimelockPendingAdmin: guardian-only queue of setPendingAdmin on the timelock.
GovernorAlpha.__executeSetTimelockPendingAdmin: guardian-only execution of setPendingAdmin on the timelock.
Timelock.executeTransaction: payable, checks admin and timelock constraints then performs an arbitrary call.
Timelock.queueTransaction: admin-only registration of a txHash with an eta constraint.
GAMERRebaser.rebase: public entry gated by msg.sender == tx.origin, computes index delta and calls gamer.rebase.
GAMERRebaser.uniswapV2Call: uniswap flash-swap callback minting/transferring tokens based on caller-supplied data.
GAMERRebaser.afterRebase: syncs the pair, buys reserve token and executes registered arbitrary transactions.
GAMERRebaser.externalCall: assembles an arbitrary low-level call to a stored destination.
GAMERRebaser.getTWAP: computes the time-weighted average price from uniswap cumulative values.
msg.sender: attacker controllable caller identity used for authority checks and vote/proposal attribution.
block.timestamp: miner-influenced clock used for eta, rebase windows, TWAP elapsed time and expiry.
tx.origin: original transaction sender used as the EOA-only gate in GAMERRebaser.rebase.
GovernorAlpha.execute loop: timelock.executeTransaction.value(proposal.values[i])(...) performs external value calls after setting proposal.executed, state changes precede interaction.
Timelock.executeTransaction: target.call.value(value)(callData) forwards arbitrary calldata and ETH to attacker-controlled target with all gas.
GAMERRebaser.externalCall: inline assembly call forwards all remaining gas to an arbitrary destination with ignored output data.
GAMERRebaser.buyReserveAndTransfer: pair.swap(...,abi.encode(uniVars)) triggers the uniswap callback before state is finalized.
GovernorAlpha.castVoteBySig: ecrecover of an EIP-712 digest to derive an arbitrary voting signatory.
GovernorAlpha.add256/sub256: manual checked addition/subtraction used for block and supply arithmetic.
proposalId parameter of queue/execute/cancel/state/getActions selecting a stored proposal.
targets array parameter of propose holding the destination addresses of proposal actions.
eta local computed in queue from block.timestamp and timelock.delay(), stored in the proposal and used for timelock transactions.
newPendingAdmin parameter of the guardian-only timelock pending admin helpers.
proposal storage pointer loaded from proposals[proposalId] in execute and cancel.

edges.reason: propose derives the caller identity and proposal proposer from msg.sender when checking gamer.getPriorVotes.
castVote passes msg.sender as the voter identity into _castVote.
castVote delegates voting logic to internal _castVote.
cancel compares msg.sender with the guardian and with the proposer vote threshold.
guardian state variable is read in the cancel authority check.
__acceptAdmin requires msg.sender to equal the guardian before calling timelock.acceptAdmin.
__queueSetTimelockPendingAdmin restricts the call to the guardian.
__executeSetTimelockPendingAdmin restricts the call to the guardian.
rebase gates execution on msg.sender == tx.origin, an EOA-only check on attacker-influenced origin.
queue computes eta as block.timestamp plus timelock.delay, a timestamp-dependent value.
state derives Expired status from block.timestamp plus the timelock grace period.
rebase timing and activation checks rely on the current block timestamp.
getTWAP derives timeElapsed from block timestamp deltas, making the oracle value manipulable within a block.
queue loops over the proposal actions invoking _queueOrRevert.
_queueOrRevert forwards each action to timelock.queueTransaction.
execute iterates proposal actions performing external value calls through the timelock.
GovernorAlpha.execute invokes Timelock.executeTransaction which continues the external call chain.
Timelock.executeTransaction performs the low-level arbitrary call to the proposal target.
rebase invokes afterRebase to perform post-rebase actions.
afterRebase triggers the uniswap swap that can re-enter this contract.
The uniswap pair calls back uniswapV2Call during pair.swap, granting reentrant control to uniswap.
afterRebase iterates enabled stored transactions and calls externalCall on each.
externalCall executes an arbitrary low-level call via inline assembly, forwarding nearly all gas.
After ecrecover the recovered signatory is passed into _castVote to record a ballot.
The timelock state variable supplies the callee used by the privileged external calls in execute.
execute reads targets, values, signatures, calldatas and eta from the proposals mapping.
queueTransaction writes the computed txHash into the queuedTransactions mapping.
buyReserveAndTransfer uses the configured uniswap pair address to perform the swap.
rebasingActive is asserted before a rebase may proceed through the rebase window check.
propose uses add256/sub256 for block number and supply arithmetic.
state uses add256 to compute eta plus grace period.
proposalId selects the proposal to queue.
proposalId selects the proposal to execute.
proposalId is used to look up the proposal state.
targets array length and contents are validated and stored when creating a proposal.
eta local is computed in queue and stored on the proposal.
newPendingAdmin is ABI-encoded into the queued timelock setPendingAdmin call.
proposal storage pointer exposes the stored actions and eta during execution.
uniswapV2Call validates msg.sender against the pair and requires sender == address(this), trusting caller-supplied callback data.
rebase calls getTWAP to obtain the exchange rate used for the supply adjustment.

normalization_plan.reason: proposalId is only a selector argument; it collapses into the external execute operation.
targets array is validated and persisted inside propose, so it merges into that function.
eta is computed and stored by queue before being forwarded to the timelock.
newPendingAdmin is only used to build the timelock setPendingAdmin payload in this guardian function.
proposal storage pointer is a transient accessor for the actions executed in the external call loop.
